recent.text: MacKenzie Weegar recorded two primary assists in the first period, notching his first multi-point game of the season. Vincent Trocheck (1a) has also extended his point streak to six games (11/16-11/27: 3g, 4a), tied for the second-longest run by any Mammoth skater in 2026-27.

popular.text: Keller’s goal completely flipped the momentum as Utah decided to get their hands dirty and generate quality chances. Defense had a few hiccups early but you can’t outshoot an opponent 14-5 and be tied at 2 after the first. Same issue they’ve had multiple times this season.
popular.author: Cole Bagley
popular.quoted_text: Utah scores twice in the last 2 minutes of the period to tie the game at 2. Offense finally generating some quality shots after outshooting Nashville 14-5. https://t.co/olOdEIjKd5

popular.text: Clayton Keller tallied two points (1g, 1a) in the final 1:27 of the first period to register his team-leading 10th multi-point game of the season. He has now found the scoresheet in 13 of Utah's 16 road contests in 2026-27, totaling a team-high 21 points (5g, 16a).
